summary: Iteration 6 testing complete. Backend 33/33 pytest passing (added 7 new tests for forgot/reset password flow covering unknown-email non-enumeration, dev token issuance, full reset flow for admin/seller/bidder with restore, single-use token, invalid token, short password 422). Frontend verified: About page has all 6 tabs (About/Delivery/Payment/Features/Contact/Address) with correct content; footer brand strip image loads (naturalWidth=893); copyright reads '© BIDBRIDGE 2023–2026 · ALL RIGHTS RESERVED' with no old '© BIDBRIDGE 2026' remaining; login-forgot-link navigates to /forgot-password; forgot-password page renders result card with dev_reset_url + working 'Open reset page' link; reset-password page reads token from ?token= query correctly; validation errors surface (Passwords do not match). Home hero image loads.

issues: Copyright text '© BIDBRIDGE 2023–2026 · ALL RIGHTS RESERVED' is concatenated directly with 'MADE IN ODISHA' with no separator/space between them in the DOM text (rendered text becomes 'ALL RIGHTS RESERVEDMADE IN ODISHA'). Consider adding a middle-dot or line break for readability. Minor.

action_items:
Optional/minor: add a separator (· or
) between the copyright string and the 'MADE IN ODISHA' tagline in Layout.jsx footer — right now they render as one glued string in accessible text.

Optional/minor: Reset page uses browser-native HTML5 minLength=6 which blocks submit before the JS 'at least 6 characters' error can render; if the spec requires the JS error to appear, drop the minLength attribute or preventDefault before native validation. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1100 lines — forgot/reset endpoints, auth, auctions, bids, admin, contact all in one file. Consider splitting into routers (auth_router, auctions_router, admin_router) once >1000 lines.
forgot-password correctly hashes tokens (SHA-256), sets 30-min expiry, marks used=true and clears login_attempts lockout — solid.
dev_reset_url + dev_token in response are explicitly documented as DEV-only. Ensure a FRONTEND_URL env var check / feature flag gates this before production.
test_credentials: Restored to canonical: admin@bidbridge.com/Admin@12345, seller@bidbridge.com/Seller@12345, bidder@bidbridge.com/Bidder@12345 (verified by post-test login inside pytest reset flow).
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Test auctions/contact submissions prefixed with TEST_.
